en.headline: MTR boosts East Rail and high-speed rail services for Chung Yeung weekend
en.dek: From Friday the operator will increase East Rail frequencies towards Lok Ma Chau and add extra short-haul high-speed trains, while K52A bus services to Tsang Tsui columbarium will also be strengthened.
body: The MTR Corporation said today it will strengthen services for the Chung Yeung Festival period to help passengers travelling for grave-sweeping.

From this Friday to next Monday, East Rail Line trains between Admiralty and Lok Ma Chau or Lo Wu will run more frequently in designated morning and evening periods. Services towards Lok Ma Chau will increase from every 10 minutes to every 8.6 minutes.

After discussions with mainland rail authorities, high-speed rail services on the Hong Kong section will also be boosted. Two extra pairs of trains to Futian or Shenzhen North will run on Friday, and 10 to 12 extra short-haul pairs to Futian each day from Saturday to Monday.
MTR Bus route K52A, linking Tuen Mun station on the Tuen Ma Line with Tsang Tsui Columbarium, will have enhanced services on weekends and public holidays this month.

zh.headline: 港鐵重陽節周末加強東鐵綫及高鐵短途服務
zh.dek: 由本周五起一連四天加密東鐵綫往落馬洲班次，並加開高鐵短途班次，K52A巴士亦加強往曾咀靈灰安置所服務。
body: 港鐵今日表示，為便利市民於重陽節期間前往掃墓，將加強相關服務。
由本周五至下周一，金鐘至落馬洲或羅湖的東鐵綫列車將於早上及晚間指定時段加密班次。往落馬洲站的班次由每10分鐘加密至每8.6分鐘一班。
經與內地鐵路單位商討，高鐵香港段將加強短途服務。本周五加開兩對來往西九龍站與福田或深圳北站的列車，周六至下周一每日加開10至12對往福田站的短途班次。
港鐵巴士K52A號線，往來屯馬綫屯門站與曾咀靈灰安置所，本月周末及公眾假期亦會加強服務。
